# [Description]
Horus is an all-in-one framework for Roblox development inspired by [CrusherFire's module loader](https://github.com/ActualFire-Games/module-loader). It provides a modular architecture for creating and managing game systems, as well as a robust remote event and remote function system for client-server communication.

This repository is for my portfolio, it wasn't made for the intention of others to use it for their games. If you want to use it for your game, feel free to fork the repository and modify it to your needs.
